split: Lexically chronological first six CSVs calibration only; final six all test, including BAD
time_origin: First finite IMU with accelerometer norm >0.5g; no truth-dependent cropping
decode: Only changed held-value channels; tdoaij=rho_j-rho_i in m; ms/1000; native acc g and gyro deg/s
calibration: Early six only: common radio/truth lag grid [-.3,.3] step .01 s minimizes per-log median absolute centered pair residual; then per-pair median and MAD clipped [.08,.5]m
test_truth: Read only after sensor-only trajectories; no spatial alignment, yaw/velocity truth, threshold selection, drift fitting
initialization: 0.6s radio CV fit from surveyed anchor centroid; gravity tilt and gyro mean from same prefix; yaw nominal zero; native original covariance; no truth
lever: Zero uncalibrated Delft lever; Toronto surveyed lever is not transferred
primary_queue: first_per_stamp: native author main first packet at each timestamp in fixed lexicographic channel order
secondary_queue: all_packets_zero_predict: native predict(dt=0) refreshes native X_hat/P_hat before each extra same-stamp packet; adaptation, not literal author main
author: Untouched backup InEKF.predict/correct, t_uv=0, original P, original .13m^2 observation variance after training pair correction
score: 100Hz causal state ZOH, searchsorted right-1; interpolate only available nonzero Optitrack; absolute XY radial RMSE and Z RMSE, no valid attitude truth so no yaw accuracy
score_correction: After first scores exposed cross-boundary interpolation artefacts, all policies/intervals changed together to causal state ZOH, preserving initial metrics as superseded; at >=27s display queries original K directly
not_independent: Four outages from each of six recordings are repeated counterfactuals; recordings are replication units
